name: site-manager
description: Site Log / Baustellenprotokoll: a phone-first site log for Swiss roofing crews.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild entry.jsx --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --jsx=automatic --alias:react=preact/compat --alias:react-dom/client=preact/compat/client --alias:react-dom=preact/compat --alias:react/jsx-runtime=preact/jsx-runtime --loader:.json=text --outdir=build --entry-names=bundle --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] && tailwindcss -i tailwind.src.css -o tailwind.css --minify && node scripts/stamp.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run test:worker && npm run test:render && npm run test:order && npm run test:dock && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:worker: node worker/files.test.mjs && node worker/limits.test.mjs && node worker/metrics.test.mjs && node worker/errors.test.mjs
